# Default Shortcuts

These are the defaults. Rebind editor shortcuts from the [shortcuts drawer](../key-bindings.md#shortcuts-drawer).

## Editor {#editor}

| Command | Action | Shortcut |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Save | `editor::Save` | `Ctrl+S` |
| Save as… | `editor::SaveAs` | `Ctrl+Shift+S` |
| Undo | `editor::Undo` | `Ctrl+Z` |
| Redo | `editor::Redo` | `Ctrl+Y` |
| Cut | `editor::Cut` | `Ctrl+X` |
| Copy | `editor::Copy` | `Ctrl+C` |
| Paste | `editor::Paste` | `Ctrl+V` |
| Select all | `editor::SelectAll` | `Ctrl+A` |
| Find | `editor::Find` | `Ctrl+F` |
| Replace | `editor::Replace` | `Ctrl+H` |
| Find next | `editor::FindNext` | `F3` |
| Find previous | `editor::FindPrevious` | `Shift+F3` |
| Go to line | `editor::GoToLine` | `Ctrl+G` |
| Close find bar | `editor::Cancel` | `Escape` |
| Delete line | `editor::DeleteLine` | `Ctrl+L` |
| Duplicate line | `editor::DuplicateLineDown` | `Ctrl+D` |
| Move line up | `editor::MoveLineUp` | `Ctrl+Shift+Up` |
| Move line down | `editor::MoveLineDown` | `Ctrl+Shift+Down` |
| Join lines | `editor::JoinLines` | `Ctrl+J` |
| UPPERCASE | `editor::ConvertToUpperCase` | `Ctrl+Shift+U` |
| lowercase | `editor::ConvertToLowerCase` | `Ctrl+U` |
| Indent | `editor::Tab` | `Tab` |
| Outdent | `editor::Backtab` | `Shift+Tab` |
| Add cursor above | `editor::AddSelectionAbove` | `Ctrl+Alt+Up` |
| Add cursor below | `editor::AddSelectionBelow` | `Ctrl+Alt+Down` |
| Move left | `editor::MoveLeft` | `Left` |
| Move right | `editor::MoveRight` | `Right` |
| Move up | `editor::MoveUp` | `Up` |
| Move down | `editor::MoveDown` | `Down` |
| Select left | `editor::SelectLeft` | `Shift+Left` |
| Select right | `editor::SelectRight` | `Shift+Right` |
| Select up | `editor::SelectUp` | `Shift+Up` |
| Select down | `editor::SelectDown` | `Shift+Down` |
| Line start | `editor::MoveToBeginningOfLine` | `Home` |
| Line end | `editor::MoveToEndOfLine` | `End` |
| Select to line start | `editor::SelectToBeginningOfLine` | `Shift+Home` |
| Select to line end | `editor::SelectToEndOfLine` | `Shift+End` |
| Previous word | `editor::MoveToPreviousWordStart` | `Ctrl+Left` |
| Next word | `editor::MoveToNextWordEnd` | `Ctrl+Right` |
| Select previous word | `editor::SelectToPreviousWordStart` | `Ctrl+Shift+Left` |
| Select next word | `editor::SelectToNextWordEnd` | `Ctrl+Shift+Right` |
| Document start | `editor::MoveToBeginning` | `Ctrl+Home` |
| Document end | `editor::MoveToEnd` | `Ctrl+End` |
| Select to document start | `editor::SelectToBeginning` | `Ctrl+Shift+Home` |
| Select to document end | `editor::SelectToEnd` | `Ctrl+Shift+End` |
| Page up | `editor::PageUp` | `Pageup` |
| Page down | `editor::PageDown` | `Pagedown` |
| Select page up | `editor::SelectPageUp` | `Shift+Pageup` |
| Select page down | `editor::SelectPageDown` | `Shift+Pagedown` |
| New line | `editor::Newline` | `Enter` |
| Delete left | `editor::Backspace` | `Backspace` |
| Delete right | `editor::Delete` | `Delete` |
| Delete previous word | `editor::DeleteToPreviousWordStart` | `Ctrl+Backspace` |
| Delete next word | `editor::DeleteToNextWordEnd` | `Ctrl+Delete` |

## Window and Panes {#window}

| Command | Action | Shortcut |
| --- | --- | --- |
| workspace: new file | `workspace::NewFile` | `Ctrl+N` |
| workspace: open file | `workspace::OpenFile` | `Ctrl+O` |
| workspace: open settings | `workspace::OpenSettings` | `Ctrl+,` |
| command palette: toggle | `command_palette::Toggle` | `Ctrl+Shift+P` |
| command palette: secondary confirm | `command_palette::SecondaryConfirm` | `Ctrl+Enter` |
| language selector: toggle | `language_selector::Toggle` | `Ctrl+K M` |
| pane: close active item | `pane::CloseActiveItem` | `Ctrl+W` |
| pane: split right | `pane::SplitRight` | `Ctrl+\` |
| pane: split up | `pane::SplitUp` | `Ctrl+K Up` |
| pane: split down | `pane::SplitDown` | `Ctrl+K Down` |
| pane: split left | `pane::SplitLeft` | `Ctrl+K Left` |
| workspace: activate pane left | `workspace::ActivatePaneLeft` | `Ctrl+K Ctrl+Left` |
| workspace: activate pane right | `workspace::ActivatePaneRight` | `Ctrl+K Ctrl+Right` |
| workspace: activate pane up | `workspace::ActivatePaneUp` | `Ctrl+K Ctrl+Up` |
| workspace: activate pane down | `workspace::ActivatePaneDown` | `Ctrl+K Ctrl+Down` |
| workspace: swap pane left | `workspace::SwapPaneLeft` | `Ctrl+K Shift+Left` |
| workspace: swap pane right | `workspace::SwapPaneRight` | `Ctrl+K Shift+Right` |
| workspace: swap pane up | `workspace::SwapPaneUp` | `Ctrl+K Shift+Up` |
| workspace: swap pane down | `workspace::SwapPaneDown` | `Ctrl+K Shift+Down` |
| app: quit | `app::Quit` | `Ctrl+Q` |
